newsitem.title: GREECE: Greek metals trader Mytilineos to hold EGM Oct 25.
newsitem.headline: Greek metals trader Mytilineos to hold EGM Oct 25.

text.p: Greek metals trader Mytilineos will hold an extraordinary shareholders meeting on October 25 on the reduction of the face value of each of its shares to 125 drachmas from 250 drachmas, it said in a statement.
The firm will issue 2,349,004 new shares that will be distributed to its shareholders free at a ratio of one new share for an old one raising the number of outstanding shares to 4,698,008, it said.
The management will make announcements about the course of the company and its future plans during the meeting, it said.
